text: Lead 2026-10-04: analysis roles stay additive in manifest@1 (precedent: reports, sources, result payloads); no @2 bump, old manifests keep their exact encoding. AnalysisResultOf states where its input lives as a named case, not an empty list: Inputs(nonEmpty distinct identity-bearing entries) | EmbeddedInPlan. EmbeddedInPlan is legal only for a family whose registry entry declares that its plan embeds its input.
